## What
Update project documentation to reflect the stateful re-review pipeline with CI/local parity, two-call architecture, and defense store.

## Changes
1. CLAUDE.md: architecture section — update review pipeline pointer (review pipeline now uses two-call architecture for cycle N>=2; DefenseStore records via defense_store_write; GitHubPRDefenseStore mirrors to PR via review-github-defense-store.sh). Update quick-reference table for mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh.
2. plugins/dso/skills/review/SKILL.md: update any references to REVIEW-DEFENSE inline comments (now migrated to tracker). Update cycle-based routing docs.
3. plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md: update any references to REVIEW-DEFENSE inline pattern.

## Acceptance Criteria
- make lint passes
- No broken references to removed patterns
